# @mission-platform/forge-router-svelte

Forge router target for Svelte and SvelteKit

## Installation

Add it to a consuming workspace member:

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "@mission-platform/forge-router-svelte": "workspace:*"
  }
}
```

## Usage

```ts
import { forgeRouterSvelte } from '@mission-platform/forge-router-svelte';
```
